{{Quote|Apparently, Idrall has issued a warning to all rivals: Tatooine is a protected area.|Airen Cracken in ''Wanted by Cracken''|<ref name="WBC" />}}
'''Jor Idrall''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. When his occasional employer, [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], [[Death/Legends|perished]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Idrall quickly moved in to fill the Hutt's power vacuum. With his new [[Idrall's organization|organization]] based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], the Twi'lek started [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] operations and extortion rackets. 

At some point between 4 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|ABY]] and [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], Idrall made his employees start a fight with [[Spy/Legends|spies]] of a [[Rethorn|rival crime lord]] on Tatooine, causing the intervention of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] troopers. When he tried to expand past the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]], the Republic issued a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] for his capture because of his many crimes. New Republic [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] later documented Idrall in his dossier ''[[Wanted by Cracken]]'' around 7 ABY.

==Biography==
===Making moves===
{{Quote|Until the death of Jabba the Hutt and the subsequent fall of his organization, Idrall was a little-known criminal who was often forced to work for Jabba.|Airen Cracken in ''Wanted by Cracken''|<ref name="WBC" />}}
[[File:Rethorn.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Idrall's employees instigated a brawl with spies of the crime lord Rethorn (pictured).]]
Jor Idrall,<ref name="WBC" /> [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] around [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] whose [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was<ref name="WBC" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], he was a two-bit,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|77|Idrall, Jor}}</ref> little-known, criminal who was often forced to work for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="WBC" /> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> Idrall moved in to fill the void left after Jabba's [[Death/Legends|death]] and the collapse of his [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal empire]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="WBC" /> an Outer Rim territory.<ref name="TEA" /> Quickly setting up a strong power base,<ref name="CSWE" /> Idrall organized his new [[Idrall's organization|crime gang]],<ref name="WBC" /> and the Twi'lek started up multiple [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] operations,<ref name="CSWE" /> attempted<ref name="WBC" /> extortion rackets, and posted [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] on fellow criminals.<ref name="CSWE" /> He also had enlisted the services of [[Qell Tepine]], the leader of the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] army [[Star's Nova]].<ref name="WBC" />

At some point between 4 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|ABY]] and [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Janson Edgewood]] made a required, brief stop on Tatooine when traveling with his troopers. While at a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in a Tatooine [[City/Legends|city]], Idrall's operatives instigated a brawl with [[Spy/Legends|spies]] for the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] crime boss [[Rethorn]], forcing Edgewood and his troopers to restore order. The commander filed a report on the incident where he made the assumption that Idrall acted tenaciously to protect his territory.<ref name="WBC" /> By 7 ABY,<ref name="Date" /> Idrall tried to expand beyond Tatooine's [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]] to eleven neighboring [[Star system/Legends|star systems]], causing the New Republic to post a bounty on his capture,<ref name="CSWE" /> one totalling 15,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on charges of [[Thief/Legends|theft]], [[racketeering]], extortion, and smuggling.<ref name="WBC" />

===Thieving Twi'lek===
{{Quote|Recent reports indicate that Idrall has many more resources than is readily apparent, or he feels that the Empire won't truly bother with him (or he's not nearly as smart as he's generally given credit for).|Airen Cracken in ''Wanted by Cracken''|<ref name="WBC" />}}
[[File:AirenCracken-WBCp4.png|thumb|left|250px|General Airen Cracken (pictured) documented and speculated on Jor Idrall in ''Wanted by Cracken''.]]
Around 7 ABY,<ref name="Date" /> at the age of thirty-seven, Idrall resided on Tatooine, where he had a small base of power with a limited part in criminal activities. He managed to expand to those eleven systems but still had not reached the level of influence of his Hutt predecessor. Any reports of the Twi'lek's influence spreading were developed by his small organization of around twenty men, and any operations done were carried out personally by Idrall and his group as they moved around systems. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] occasionally approached Idrall, but he refused to work with them and stole supplies from them, selling the resources to [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], mercenaries, [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], and [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]. He ultimately suffered losses, as the criminal [[Talon Karrde|Talon Karrde's]] smuggling organization grew rapidly compared to Idrall's, and Karrde's group was on track to control a large amount of the crime in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="WBC" />

New Republic [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] documented Idrall in his dossier ''[[Wanted by Cracken]]'', where he detailed his history and made the assumption that surviving the carnage that followed in the wake of Jabba's death helped Idrall in his mysterious rise to power. A personal addendum from the general noted the Twi'lek's operations and his rebuffing of approaches by the Empire, based off of recent reports. Cracken wrote that it appeared Idrall had more resources than it seemed or that he felt that the Empire would not truly bother with him.<ref name="WBC" />

==Personality and traits==
Idrall, a man considered evil, stood at 1.75 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="WBC" /> He employed public displays of violence at local cantinas with his thugs to send the message that he had taken over to any potential crime lords.<ref name="CSWE" /> When writing his dossier, Cracken included the possibility that Idrall's refusal of the Galactic Empire was because he was not as smart as he was generally given credit.<ref name="WBC" />

==Skills and abilities==
Idrall could operate [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[blaster artillery]] and could perform melee combat, in which the non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Twi'lek dodged and carried out parries. Technical skills of his included [[Computer/Legends|computer]] programming and repair, demolition, [[Droid/Legends|droid]] programming and repair, first aid, and security. Idrall could also beast-ride and use [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles. The street-smart criminal was knowledgeable on several topics, including [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]], [[Language/Legends|language]], bureaucracy, cultures, and planetary systems. Bargaining, conning, and command were perceptive skills employed by Idrall when dealing with others. As he was a Twi'lek,<ref name="WBC" /> he could use his head [[Limb/Legends|tentacles]]<ref name="RPG2">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'', Second Edition]]</ref>&mdash;known as [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]]<ref name="TEGtAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>&mdash;for secret communication.<ref name="RPG2" />

==Equipment==
Idrall used a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], and a blaster. At one point in his life, while he directed someone, he wore dark [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] that featured a textured chest piece.<ref name="WBC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jor Idrall was introduced in ''[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|Wanted by Cracken]]'', a [[1993]] supplement book for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'', written by [[Louis J. Prosperi]] and published by [[West End Games]]. Artist [[Mike Vilardi]] illustrated the image of the character.<ref name="WBC" />
